tasks.name: AI Design
tasks.objective: Produce the AI Design for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every AI archetype listed with role, senses and decision model
Fairness rules stated: reaction time, accuracy and information limits
Navigation and spawn constraints stated per archetype

tasks.name: Behaviour and Navigation Systems
tasks.objective: Produce the Behaviour and Navigation Systems for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every archetype implemented and observable in a build
Pathfinding handles the whole playable space without getting stuck
AI update cost measured per frame against its budget

tasks.name: AI Validation
tasks.objective: Produce the AI Validation for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: No archetype can be farmed with a single degenerate strategy
Stuck, idle or unreachable agents counted at zero in a soak run
Reaction time measured and within the fairness rule
